optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Model Evaluation Engineer with a proven track record of maintaining evaluation harnesses, managing labelled review sets, and driving significant reductions in false-alert rates for wealth advisory platforms.
professionalSummary.witness: The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the model evaluation harness and expanded the labelled adviser-review set by 1,200 new alerts over the year.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran pre-release evaluations for all four model versions released in the year and published comprehensive evaluation reports to the model team and adviser operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated release decisions in model release meetings, ensuring clear responsibility boundaries and alignment with model team leads and adviser operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated release decisions in the model release meeting; the model team lead took the go/no-go decision and adviser operations confirmed the alert-volume impact.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored evaluation notes detailing review-set composition, known limitations, and hand-over items for each model version.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing the review-set composition, the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Quarterly false-alert report and version 3.2 evaluation notes, including batch runner job identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the quarterly false-alert report (rate per quarter, baseline line, version 3.2 marker) and the evaluation notes for version 3.2, with the batch runner's job identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Python, batch scheduling, model evaluation harness development, labelled data management, false-alert rate analysis, release coordination, documentation of evaluation assumptions and limitations.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with evaluation harness maintenance, labelled review set management, pre-release evaluation execution, false-alert rate reduction, release coordination, and documentation of evaluation assumptions. They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s ability to independently reduce false-alert rates beyond the documented threshold recalibration or of any broader strategic impact beyond the platform’s quarterly baseline.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate demonstrates strong evidence for all role requirements but further verification of strategic impact and independent initiative is recommended.
